authority.source_of_truth: Reviewed method specification, executable schema, generated bundle rules, validator source, and regeneration evidence.
authority.task_authority: Specs, plans, tests, and task leaves with explicit traceability and frozen acceptance criteria.
authority.acceptance_authority: Independent schema and bundle validation, generated-artifact consistency, compatibility tests, and reproducible regeneration.
authority.deployment_authority: No production authority; generated task bundles remain candidate planning artifacts until independently accepted by the target repository.

data.retention: Method versions, schemas, examples, generation receipts, failures, and compatibility results remain version controlled.
data.deletion: Invalid or superseded generated bundles are removed from active examples while their compatibility and migration history remains attributable.
data.secret_storage: Target-repository credentials and private specifications remain outside public examples and generated fixtures.

change_control.rollback_or_revocation: Method and schema versions are superseded with explicit migration and compatibility evidence; target repositories retain final authority.

stabilization.summary: Finish a small validator that proves spec-plan-test-task traceability, leaf executability, and schema conformance before broader adoption.
Replace enormous generated task and execution files with compact human review views plus content-addressed machine detail.
Pin generator/runtime versions and prove deterministic regeneration and forward/backward compatibility.
